items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: we'd date a minstrel show come to one of these little old small towns, like Ma Rainey was on. This was after Ma Rainey had left the medicine show, and Ma Rainey was with a show called

ctx.x: Like a buck dance and all that kind of stuff.

Yeah. [LAUGHS] And I got such a big kick out of that, you know, especially going into these little old small towns and being noticed -- you know. That was a kind of thrill. But in the back of my mind all the time, as soon as I get a chance, I'm going with the Al G. Barnes Circus. A lot of times we'd date a circus. What I mean, we'd play, and a circus would come to the same town where we was playing, and we'd always get together, or we'd date a minstrel show come to one of these little old small towns, like Ma…
